title: Referrals
description: Track every submission from start to hire: candidates you sent to partner jobs, and candidates partners sent to yours.

sent.title: No referrals sent yet
sent.description: When a partner job fits one of your candidates, submit them from Opportunities. You'll follow their progress here.

received.title: No submissions received yet
received.description: Publish a job open to partners. Recruiters with matching candidates can then submit them to you.

detail.title: Referral
detail.submittedFlash: Submitted. {partner} has been notified and can now see only the fields you approved.
detail.revoked: The candidate's sharing authorization was revoked on {date}.
detail.revokedTarget: The shared profile and documents are no longer available to you.
detail.revokedSource: The partner no longer has access to the snapshot or documents.
detail.guidanceTarget: Review the approved profile, then decide. Feedback must be job-related and non-discriminatory.
detail.guidanceSource: Keep the partner updated. Withdrawing stops their access to further documents.
detail.disclosed: Disclosed fields: {fields}. Snapshot taken {date}; later edits to the source record are not shared.

agreement.title: Collaboration agreement
agreement.pending: Created automatically from the current commission rule when the job owner accepts. The snapshot is frozen after that.
agreement.internal: Internal referral: both organizations share a member, so there's no sourcing commission. The job owner keeps that share; the platform fee is unchanged.

fit.title: Fit with the job
fit.hint: Indicative score, frozen when the candidate was submitted.

next.waitingBody: You'll be notified as soon as they update this referral.
next.hired: Hired · the placement is now tracked in your wallet.
next.awaitingSent: Email sent to {email} {time}. The link expires on {date}. {partner} only sees the referral after confirmation.
next.awaitingNotSent: The email to {email} has not been sent yet.
next.awaitingExpired: The link sent to {email} expired on {date}. Resend to create a new one.
next.candidateDeclinedBody: {partner} was not notified and never had access to any information.

detail.awaitingFlash: Referral created. We emailed {email}; it will be delivered to {partner} as soon as the candidate confirms.
detail.awaitingNotSentFlash: Referral created, but the email to the candidate was not sent. Use “Resend email” below.

actions.declineHint: Share job-related, non-discriminatory feedback. It will be visible to the partner recruiter.
actions.noteHint: Your note is recorded in the referral timeline and visible to the partner.

agreement.title: Confirm collaboration agreement
agreement.description: You agree to the commission split shown, frozen for this referral. Template terms are a draft pending legal review; confirm your own contractual obligations separately.

hire.title: Report a successful hire
hire.description: Creates the placement using the frozen agreement. Commission stays projected until the client payment is verified.

message.label: Message
message.placeholder: Professional, job-related messages only. Visible to both recruiters.

form.step1Body: Only checked fields are copied into an immutable snapshot for {recipient}. Your private notes and the original record are never shared.
form.authAfter: . A resume upload alone does not authorize sharing.
form.legalBasisHint: Draft options — confirm with privacy counsel.
form.evidenceHint: e.g. 'Candidate approved by email on 2026-11-06 after reviewing the role summary.'
form.confirmInterest: I confirmed the candidate is interested in this specific role and approved sharing the selected information.
form.notePlaceholder: Context for the job owner: motivation, notice period, why this is a fit…
form.anonymous: The candidate stays anonymous to the partner unless you add identifying fields.
form.revocation: If the authorization is revoked later, the partner immediately loses access to the snapshot and documents.
form.methodEmail: Ask the candidate to confirm by email
form.methodEmailHint: We email a private link to {email}. The referral stays “Awaiting candidate approval” and is delivered to {partner} automatically once they confirm. Through the link, the candidate can also update their own profile.
form.methodEmailMissing: No email on the candidate's profile. Add one to ask for confirmation.
form.methodRecorded: I already have the candidate's authorization
form.methodRecordedHint: Record how and when the candidate authorized it (e.g. by phone).

validation.selectField: Select at least one field to share
validation.confirmInterest: Confirm the candidate is interested in this role
validation.describeAuthorization: Describe how the candidate authorized sharing with this recruiter for this job

errors.opportunityGone: This opportunity is no longer available.
errors.candidateEmailFailed: We couldn't email the candidate. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.emailNotConfigured: Email delivery is not configured in this environment.

success.statusUpdated: Status updated. The partner has been notified.
success.agreementConfirmed: Agreement confirmed. Commission terms are now frozen for this referral.

caughtUp.title: All caught up
caughtUp.description: No submissions waiting for a decision. New ones appear here and in your notifications.

queue.selectHint: Select rows to decline several at once
queue.noScore: No fit score for this submission
queue.revokedLong: The candidate revoked sharing. The profile and documents are no longer available.
queue.noMessages: No messages yet. Open the full page to write one.
queue.declineHint: The partner sees the reason. Keep it job-related.
queue.infoTitle: Ask the partner for more information
queue.infoHint: The referral pauses until the partner answers.
queue.infoPlaceholder: e.g. Can you share their notice period and recent projects?

done.accepted: Accepted. The collaboration agreement was created.

received.title: Referrals received
received.description: Candidates partner recruiters submitted to your open jobs. Review each one and move them forward or decline.

sent.title: Referrals sent
sent.description: Your candidates submitted to partner recruiters' jobs, from submission to hire.

composer.skillsVsJob: Checked against the job's required skills
composer.shareHint: Use the eye on each section to share or hide it. Only what's shared is copied into the snapshot.
